# zurich2026

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/danielinteractive/zurich2026/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/danielinteractive/zurich2026/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

This package was used to illustrate the Zurich workshop in October 2026.

## Installation

You can install the development version of zurich2026 from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("danielinteractive/zurich2026")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r}
#| label: example
library(zurich2026)
hello("Ben")
```
